detail: The signIn helper shared by all three tests is declared as `signIn(page: Page, demo: Demo,username: string)`, with no space after the comma. Prettier would reformat it and the PR style check would likely flag it; it should be `demo: Demo, username: string`.

The 'Signed in as alice/bob' highlight labels never appear in any keyframe (01-highlight-signed-in-as-* shows only the home hero), so no frame identifies the user the case requires. TC-PRB-1-03's item-page frame also never shows /item/99 or the item heading. The tests' sign-in assertions only check that the home page appears; a caption naming the user (and the item URL) would let the video identify the case. Applies to TC-PRB-1-01/02 as well.

The 'Signed in as bob/alice' highlight frames show only the home page with the account icon. The highlight label is not drawn, so no frame or caption names the signed-in user. The /item/99 URL is never captioned either (only the item name appears). The same identity gap applies to TC-PRB-1-01 and TC-PRB-1-02. A demo.caption naming the user and the item URL would fix it.
